description: Acquedotto Storico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappe.comune.genova.it. Map that represents the reconstructed route of the historic aqueduct with indicated access points, information panels and historical artifacts. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Historical aqueduct" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, manufatti, percorsi, sentieri, acqua potabile, acquedotto. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
